IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Senate Committee on Commerce & Trade (originally sponsored by Senators Hewitt and Prentice)

Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing multiple daily drawing on-line games.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to multiple daily drawing online games; and addinga new section to chapter 67.70 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 67.70 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Pursuant to RCW 67.70.040(1)(f), the commission may offer onlinegames in which the drawing or selection of winning tickets occurs morethan once every twentyfour hours.
